train_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Email, T1.PhoneNumber FROM customers AS T1 INNER JOIN rootbeerreview AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID WHERE T2.StarRating > 3 AND T1.City = 'Sacramento' AND T2.ReviewDate BETWEEN '2014-01-01' AND '2014-12-31'
